name: MATH 2720
title: History of Mathematics
description: A historical study of the growth of the various fields of mathematics. This course may not be counted in any of the major groups described in the Mathematics Departmental listing.
requirement_description: Either (i) MATH 2110Q or MATH 2130Q, and either MATH 2210 or MATH 2410Q, or (ii) MATH 2144Q or MATH 2420Q.
